title: What a Godly Man Does With a Grudge (It's Not Forgetting)
caption:
Forgiving isn't forgetting. Joseph remembered every bit of it and still fed his brothers.

Save this for the name that came to mind. Pray for him tonight.

Who are you carrying a grudge against?

#faith #forgiveness #godlymen #christianman #genesis50
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
